lines.en: Earlier today, I decided to be a responsible teacher and asked Yumi to come to my office after school.
I have no idea whether or not she actually will, but I figure that something like this is the least I can do to prevent her from...continuing to be an asshole, I guess?
I'm still in the dark about what happened during gym class the other day, but I know that whatever it was seemed to really get to Futaba.
Worst case scenario, I could always give Yumi a formal detention or something like that, but...I'm pretty sure that would require me staying later as well.
And despite the seemingly endless supply of cute girls in this school, I still think I'd prefer to spend my time here outside of this place...
: I'm here. The fuck do you want?
: You know you’re supposed to knock, right?
: And you know you’re lucky I even showed up for whatever this bullshit is, right?
: So why don't you save both of us the time and just fucking get to it already? What do I have to do today?
: Why do you have to be so hostile all the time? I didn't call you here for the sole purpose of pissing you off, you know.
: Yeah, no fucking shit you didn't.
: You know you can talk to me if something is wrong, right? You don't have to just take it out on everyone else.
: Is this a fucking joke? Did you seriously just say that to me?
: I...think so?
: You think I, Yumi Yamaguchi- the girl you fuck with more than anybody, am going to just open up to you because you said it's okay?
: Suck my fucking dick, dude. No.
: Ain't a chance in hell that shit is gonna happen.
Yeah, that's more or less the response I expected.
She can't keep me in the dark forever, though...can she?
: Hah...not sure where this sudden change of heart's comin' from or if this is just another one of your backwards-ass discipline tactics, but...
: Please, kindly fuck off.
: You hate me, I hate you. That’s how this shit goes. That's how this shit stays.
: If you want to keep me after for another fucking detention, just say it. I ain't got time for you to talk in circles and shit.
: Just say it and I'll be on my way. Every second I spend with you in here brings me one step closer to puking all over your shitty carpet.
Wow, Yumi...might hate me even more than I thought she did?
Just what was her impression of the last me like?
: I'm not going to give you detention, Yumi. I was thinking that maybe we could try something else.
: Something like what? Because God only knows what kinda shit somebody like you might have in mind.
: To be honest, I don't really have anything in mind.
Nothing that I can seriously ask her to do, at least.
: Oh, really? So you're not thinking of some crazy perverted shit right now?
: You are fucking pathetic.
: Listen, the fact of the matter is that I can’t let you humiliate and berate the other girls whenever you want.
: I wasn’t fuckin’ 'berating' anyone! Is this about that shit in gym yesterday?
: What did that fat, fucking bitch say to you? Because I've got no problem marching over to her stupid ass dorky club and beating the living shit out of her right fucking now.
: See, that's exactly what I'm talking about. That is berating someone.
: Don't expect me to know fuckin' stupid ass words like that, dick!
: Yumi, what did Futaba ever do to you? Why do you have to treat her like this even when she isn't around to hear it?
: Fuck if I know. She’s probably planning on stealing my lunch or some shit.
: And, wait! Why the hell are you even on her side?!
: You into that BBW shit all of a sudden? You bein' nice to her just so you can fuck her and fulfill another creepy ass fetish of yours?
: If I was, would it even make a difference?
: Yes! A fucking disgusting difference!
: You're seriously attracted to that? She's like what would happen if a fuckin' beached whale spent the night in a perfume factory and then fucked all the workers.
: You can't be fuckin' serious right now!
: You know, if you're creative enough to come up with metaphors like that, you might actually have some promise as a writer one day.
: Oh, fan-fucking-tastic. Here comes the part where you compliment me because your fetish isn't just overweight teenagers, it is literally all of them.
: For someone who apparently hates me, you sure seem to care a lot about who I'm attracted to.
: I wouldn't care as much if I didn't have to see you every fuckin' day.
: I mean...you don't. Not as much as everyone else, at least.
: Gee, I wonder why.
: Listen, I'll stop talkin' shit about all your creepy ass fetishes so long as you promise to keep me out of 'em. Got it?
: I’ve got shit I need to do and things I need to take care of.
: And I can guarantee you that the last thing I fuckin’ need is some cradle-robber breathing down my neck with his tiny little dick in his hand.
: And now you're berating my penis. Where does it end, Yumi? Where does it end?
: It ends right fucking here!
: You are fucking hopeless! And you are fucking disgusting!
: I swear, it's like you expect us all to just throw ourselves at you because you’re some sort of “man in power” or something!
: Fuck that! No! I still can’t believe this place even hired someone like you!
To be fair, they kind of didn’t...
: Yumi...
: What? All out of shit to say? That's new.
: No, I just...can’t really figure out how I’m supposed to talk to you.
: Yeah, well, that’s probably because you’re not supposed to talk to me.
: I hate this fucking[school]. I hate 99%% of the fucking girls in it. And I hate you, more than both of those other things combined.
: And I ain't gonna stop making fun of Futaba just because you're trying to fuck her.
: I don't have anything to do with why you should stop making fun of Futaba. You should stop making fun of Futaba because she hasn’t done anything wrong.
: You didn't even fucking deny that you’re trying to fuck her! You just deflected!
: You’re lucky I’m not calling the fucking cops!
: You do know that if you keep this up, you're just going to keep winding up in here, right?
: You obviously don't want to be here since you have so much shit to do, so just try and be less of a dick and you'll have more of that time to yourself and less of it hanging around me.
: Good, cause there are very few things in life that I hate more than being around you.
: I'm sure there are.
: So...am I free to go now or what?
I probably shouldn’t let her leave just yet, but I honestly have no idea what else I can do at this point.
People like this are impossible to help because they don't want to be helped.
Which, in turn, just makes everyone else suffer.
What I did here today won't help Futaba at all. It won't help anyone at all. It was nothing more than a waste of time.
But...
At least it allowed Yumi to vent a little. And, as a temporary optimist, I'm going to hope that prevents her from hurting anyone else for at least a day or two.
: Yeah...
: You can go.
: Cool. Bye.
And just like that, Yumi is gone.
It’s hard to believe that in a class as obedient and...excitable as mine that there’s an outlier like her.
People don't become that way overnight.
Something must have happened to her.
I leave my office and lock the door.
Before I know it, I’m on my way home.
